recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the XML half of the Published decision without changing the already-correct JSON rule or restoring fhir_comments.
issue_request: FHIR-8814 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested removal of JSON comments plus XML guidance that systems handling resources may ignore or reject comments and that other systems must not expect preservation or behavior changes because of them.
initial_application: The JSON portion was already applied: current source/json.html forbids JSON comments, and commit 75b64c909d (#10656) removed the historical fhir_comments support. The exact XML handling rule was not found in history, and source/xml.html only said comments, processing instructions, and formatting were not part of resource contents.
additional_context: FHIR-10656 records the later Published/Persuasive JSON-only removal and svn revision 10171. FHIR-8666 was resolved No Change after comments were no longer supported in FHIR JSON. Zulip consultation and implementer discussion confirm fhir_comments was deliberately withdrawn while ordinary XML comments may still appear but are not meaningful FHIR content. publish.ini lists json.html and xml.html as active pages.
reconciliation: Updated source/xml.html to state that systems handling resources MAY ignore or reject instances containing XML comments, and systems SHALL NOT expect other systems to preserve comments or behave differently because of them.
source_changes: source/xml.html:63 - added explicit XML comment ignore/reject and preservation-expectation guidance.

related_jiras.note: Published JSON-specific removal of fhir_comments; its recorded svn revision matches the existing source history for the JSON half.
Resolved No Change after the work group concluded comments were no longer supported in FHIR JSON, making XML-to-JSON comment mapping unnecessary.
Earlier Published issue added JSON comment examples before the later removal decisions superseded that JSON-comments approach.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requiring removal of JSON comments and XML guidance for systems handling resource comments.
evidence_items.learned: This is final WG intent and establishes the missing XML handling rule for the current source check.

evidence_items.summary: The JSON format page states that comments SHALL NOT be in JSON instances irrespective of whether applications ignore them.
evidence_items.learned: The JSON half of FHIR-8814 is already reflected in active source and does not need another edit.

evidence_items.summary: The XML format page is active build-source and previously only said XML comments are not resource contents.
evidence_items.learned: The active XML format page was the correct place to add the explicit ignore/reject and preservation-expectation guidance.

evidence_items.summary: Commit #10656 removed the fhir_comments property text and related JSON comment references from source/json.html.
evidence_items.learned: Historical application covered JSON comment removal but did not add the FHIR-8814 XML handling rule.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue approving removal of the JSON fhir_comments feature after implementer consultation.
evidence_items.learned: This explains why the current JSON page should remain comment-free while FHIR-8814's XML note is completed.

evidence_items.summary: Resolved No Change issue about where XML comments map in JSON, with the motion that comments are no longer supported in FHIR JSON.
evidence_items.learned: The comment-removal decision removed the need for JSON/XML comment mapping and supports a narrow XML semantics clarification.

evidence_items.summary: The community consultation thread proposed removing support for comments in the FHIR JSON format and recorded no blocking objection in the captured discussion.
evidence_items.learned: Community evidence is consistent with the Jira decision to keep JSON comments removed.

evidence_items.summary: Later implementer discussion says fhir_comments is no longer valid, XML comments can still appear, and comments are clinically meaningless.
evidence_items.learned: The current-source fix should clarify XML handling without introducing a JSON comment mapping.
